newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, with gasoline weaker and naphtha firmer, traders said.
Gasoline was slightly weaker but off earlier lows. Eurograde traded at $188.50 and $190 for April delivery, and $192 for May.
Naphtha recovered from Monday's dip into the low $180s, with April and May swaps both quoted around the $186/$187 levels.
High sulphur fuel barges gained $1 on bunker demand but cargoes were quiet. Low sulphur cargoes were stable, but good supply and weak straight-run will pressure values.
Gas oil firmed 75 cents to $163 a tonne on the April IPE, while steady French buying helped strengthen diesel premiums.
